In Venlo, you'll work at a family business specialising in young plants, where fresh products are packaged and prepared for shipment every day. While the lines are running, you continuously monitor quality and progress. 
If a machine jams, you know how to act quickly. You resolve minor technical faults independently, and for bigger issues, you communicate clearly with your colleagues in Dutch, German or English. Alongside the technical work, you keep the administration around traceability, batch numbers and KPIs neat and up to date. Because you're a real hands-on worker, you don't mind helping out with manual packing work when the schedule requires it. The workday often starts early, and you'll work 38 hours per week, with a willingness to work an average of two Saturdays a month or in shifted schedules between 04:00 and 21:00. You'll find yourself in a great workplace with dedicated colleagues and plenty of job security.

About the job: 
As a Prefab Carpenter, you are responsible for making wooden moulds for precast concrete elements such as balconies and galleries. You work from technical drawings and ensure every mould is built accurately to meet production and quality standards. Your work plays an important role in the manufacturing process of high-quality concrete components. 
Your daily tasks include: 
• Making wooden moulds for precast balconies and galleries 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings 
• Measuring, cutting, and assembling wooden formwork 
• Checking dimensions and ensuring high-quality workmanship 
• Maintaining tools and keeping the workplace clean and organized 
• Working according to safety regulations 
What we ask: 
• Proven experience as a Prefab Carpenter or Formwork Carpenter 
• Ability to read technical drawings 
• Experience with woodworking tools and measuring equipment 
• Own hand tools and work clothing 
• Ability to work accurately and independently 
• Good command of Dutch, German, or English
